task8_DS_empty_reasons.interpretation: The frozen runner parser (phase3_run._parse_answer_json) only strips a leading ``` fence then json.loads the WHOLE string; answers with a prose prefix before the JSON object, and truncated JSON, yield {} and thus an empty reason. Those rows still carry a valid parsed VERDICT (parsed separately) and the prose/tool trace preserves the substantive rationale, so the empty structured-reason field is a serialization/parse artifact, not necessarily a missing rationale. Mechanism attribution should use the raw answer/trace, not the empty reason field.
